title: Descended open charts with compatible local maps
statement: Let p:X→Y be an fpqc singleton of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], let V→X carry a descent datum D [def-pd-descent-datum], and let U_i be any open covering of V. Let E_i be descent data on U_i→X whose transport maps, after inclusion in V, agree with those of D. Suppose W_i→Y and q_i:U_i→W_i give cartesian squares with p, and q_i is invariant under every transport of E_i. Then there exist W_0→Y and open immersions j_i:W_i→W_0 jointly covering W_0, with j_i over Y, such that on U_i×_V U_k the composites through q_i and j_i and through q_k and j_k agree for all i,k. No global morphism from V is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Descent, Tag 0AP4, construction of the overlaps U_ij and the glued scheme before the final global map

proof.text: Obtain only the local overlap schemes, open inclusions, diagonal identities, transition and triple-cocycle maps, and cartesian intersection lifts from exists_descended_overlap_glue_data. No glued scheme is supplied by this theorem.

Base change p along each W_i to show q_i is an fpqc singleton, then base change q_i along f i k using the cartesian intersection lift r. The singleton is flat and surjective, so Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective (Stacks Tag 02VW) makes r an epimorphism. Cancel r in the equation f i k followed by W_i to Y = t i k followed by f k i and W_k to Y. The remaining equation follows from the two lift factorizations, the original cartesian squares, and pullback.condition. This is the fully proved private helper epi_of_fpqc_singleton and the local proof hbase.

Construct Scheme.GlueData explicitly from the supplied local overlap data. Its glued scheme and chart inclusions are provided by Mathlib. The inclusions are open immersions and jointly surjective. The previous base equations give a multicofork of maps to Y, so Multicoequalizer.desc constructs its structure map a. Multicoequalizer.pi_desc proves each inclusion is over Y. Set W_0=Over.mk a.

For each i,k precompose Scheme.GlueData.glue_condition with r i k. Substitute the first-projection factorization from its pullback square and its second-projection transition equation. Associativity gives exactly the required overlap equation. No global map from V is constructed. The original covering assumption is retained in the signature but is not needed for gluing this family; empty I is covered by the same construction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_glued_model_structure
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (hcover : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (W₀ : Over Y) (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left),
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
      (∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w) ∧
      (∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom) ∧
      (∀ i k, pullback.fst (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q i ≫ j i =
        pullback.snd (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q k ≫ j k)
